newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT - Guangdong Inv rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Guangdong Inv rated buy.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said it has upgraded its intermediate rating on Guangdong Investment Ltd to buy from neutral and raised its 1997 earnings per share estimate to HK$0.349 from HK$0.338, while maintaining its 1996 forecast.

Merrill said Guangdong Investment has underperformed the Hang Seng index by about five percent this year, due partly to a shift in the market to more speculative red chips. "In our opinion, GDI's continued share price under-performance is unjustified, given its quality of earnings, and its proven management track record," it said a November 18 report.
Merrill forecasts earnings per share of HK$0.288 in 1996.

The report said property investment, travel and hotels, and infrastructure are expected to continue accounting for about 45-50 percent of Guangdong Investment's operating profits in 1996 to 1998. "Given the current business mix, we think GDI is more an earnings growth story, instead of an asset play."
It said potential listings of various businesses should help the company realise some of the captive values of its assets.
"In light of the industrial division's increased capital expenditure requirements, we believe that GDI is rife with potential spin-off opportunities in 1997," it added.
